title: Half an emoji
objective: Enter a non-empty UTF-16 code-unit sequence that is not structurally well-formed.

inputs.label: UTF-16 units
inputs.description: Hexadecimal code units separated by spaces.

graphDescription: This path models UTF-16 directly, so unpaired surrogates are preserved.
hints: Supplementary scalars use a high surrogate followed by a low surrogate.
Remove either half of a valid surrogate pair.
Try the lone high-surrogate code unit D83E.
explanation: UTF-16 code units can contain unpaired surrogates even though Unicode scalar sequences cannot. Validation must detect that structure explicitly instead of silently replacing it.
